# Nova Heritage Group LLC

> Accounting and tax firm in Lee's Summit, Missouri, serving small businesses of every kind and individuals across the Kansas City metro (Missouri and Kansas) and remotely nationwide. Monthly QuickBooks Online bookkeeping, catch-up and cleanup, payroll, sales tax, and business and personal tax preparation with e-filing, on flat monthly plans from $149 a month (an outsourced accounting department), plus a fractional CFO plan for contractors. Works with contractors and trades, professional services, retail and e-commerce, real estate investors, new businesses, and individuals. Not a CPA firm; does not perform audits, reviews, compilations, or other attest services.

## Key facts

- Location: Lee's Summit, MO (Kansas City metro). Serves the whole KC metro on both sides of the state line, and clients anywhere in the U.S. remotely.
- Credentials: QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor, Level 2. B.S. Accounting, M.A. Economics.
- Software: QuickBooks Online and QuickBooks Payroll; Xero for clients already on it.
- Clients: any small business (contractors and trades, professional services, retail and e-commerce, real estate investors and landlords, new businesses) plus individuals and families who need personal returns.
- Founder: Greg Novakowski, QuickBooks Online ProAdvisor Level 2, B.S. Accounting, B.A. and M.A. Economics, full-charge bookkeeping and data analytics background.
- Terms: fixed fees, month-to-month, 30 days' notice to cancel. Books closed by the 10th of each month, or that month is free. First month of any monthly plan refunded if the client doesn't want to continue.
- Contact: book a 15-minute fit call at https://calendly.com/greg-novaheritagegroupllc/fit-call · greg@novaheritagegroupllc.com · (913) 213-3503

## Pricing (flat monthly plans; month-to-month)

- Autopilot Books: $149/month. Automated bank and card feed categorization reviewed every month, reconciliation check, P&L, one-page dashboard and a short note by the 10th, year-end package for the tax preparer. Email support (2 business days). Simple businesses with no employees and no sales tax, up to 40 transactions a month, one bank account and one card, one entity. Details: https://novaheritagegroupllc.com/autopilot-books/
- Launch: $250/month. Monthly books, simple P&L, QuickBooks setup help, 1099s for up to 5 contractors. New and solo businesses, no employees, up to 50 transactions a month.
- S-Corp Owner: $399/month. For a one-person S-corp where the owner is the only one on payroll: monthly books closed by the 10th, owner payroll with all payroll tax filings and the owner's W-2, the federal 1120-S and Missouri S-corp return, and a quarterly check that the owner's salary is still reasonable. Up to 50 transactions a month. One-time setup $500, covering the S-corp election and owner payroll setup. S-corps with employees go on Full Department.
- Essentials (most popular): $500/month. Launch plus payroll, payroll tax filings, W-2s and 1099s, sales tax filings (up to 2 states), monthly dashboard, closed by the 10th. 1–5 employees, up to 150 transactions a month.
- Full Department: $1,000/month. Essentials plus the business tax return (1120-S or 1065) and a quarterly planning call. 6–15 employees, up to 400 transactions a month.
- Department + Insights (fractional CFO): from $1,500/month. Full Department plus a live profit dashboard (13-week cash forecast, profit by job, receivables), monthly review call, budget vs. actual and a 12-month forecast. For contractors and growing businesses doing about $750k a year or more; larger contractors needing job costing with a WIP schedule or a bank or bonding package are quoted from $2,000.
- Owner Dashboard & Cash Review: $125/month add-on for owners who keep their own bookkeeper.
- Setup fee: $250 (Launch, Essentials) or $500 (Full Department and up); waived when signing within 7 days of the fit call.
- Catch-up / cleanup: $375 per month behind ($500 minimum), $190 per month behind with a plan.
- Personal tax return (1040, federal + Missouri): from $199; with Schedule C from $349; $149 for owners on a monthly plan ($249 with Schedule C).
- 1099 preparation: $125 for up to 5 forms, $15 each after; free when starting a monthly plan by January 15.
- Business tax return (1120-S, 1065): from $850; $650 for monthly-plan clients; included in S-Corp Owner and Full Department.
- Payroll only: from $175/month. QuickBooks setup and training: $450. S-corp election and payroll setup: $750, or $500 with a monthly plan. Profit & Cash Review: $200 one-time (last 12 months of profit by month and job, 13-week cash forecast, 60-minute walkthrough, top 3 fixes), refunded if the client doesn't find it worth it; $250 off a monthly plan started within 60 days.
